details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The narrative progresses from overall financial performance (profit decline) to specific drivers (interest income, expenses), then to balance sheet developments (loan/deposit growth), and finally to capital management actions and ratings. The relationships between causes and effects are clearly articulated (e.g., S2 explains S1, S3 explains part of S4, S5 shows expense impact). There is no unnecessary repetition, and the summary forms a clear, logical whole covering profitability, operational metrics, balance sheet trends, and strategic actions. No arithmetic contradictions are present or implied.
